linkedin_activity.text: My friend Dr Hasan Iqbal is building Tendn , and you guys need to hear about it. Please consider following to support his journey and he'd love to connect with fellow health-tech founders in the space! As a GP registrar with an interest in sports and exercise medicine, Hasan realised a gap when it came to ultrasound training. Wouldn't it be great to have real-time feedback on your technique when a senior clinician isn't available? It's not like you can easily judge your own progress during self-directed sessions without an expert guiding you. Enter Tendn - an AI solution designed to give real-time feedback by identifying the anatomy on screen, and providing corrective guidance frame by frame. You can register your interest at https://tendn.app - and go follow Hasan Iqbal and Tendn to stay updated! ...more

🚨⚠️ "THE NEXT PANDEMIC IS COMING!" ⚠️🚨 🦠 If you thought I was talking about hantavirus, I wouldn't blame you. 🤷‍♂️ 📰 Because, ever since COVID, there are a lot of headlines that sound like this. 🤝 That's why I've contributed to this article with Patient Information Forum (PIF) as a Trusted Information Creator, about news headlines that endlessly talk about "the next pandemic". 🔗 READ IT HERE: https://lnkd.in/eeBXbEuK 😷 Pandemics are scary - yes. 🤔 But when the media's focus is gaining attention, sometimes risk analysis and nuance fall by the wayside. 🥼 That's why, now more than ever, subject matter experts are needed - to bring context to the headlines. 📸 Yes, I'm preparing videos about hantavirus - but I'd rather make a measured video based on the evidence, rather than a rushed clickbait video that risks fearmongering and misinformation. 🔥 Thanks to Rosa Legeno-Bell (MA, GTP, BA) for preparing this great article, and shout-out to Dr Sasan Shekarestan for his brilliant contributions! 🗨️ What are your thoughts on "next pandemic" headlines? Let me know in the comments! ...more

✨ Very proud of my latest collab with the Department for Transport (DfT), United Kingdom 🚫🍷 There is NO safe level of alcohol consumption, especially when it comes to driving. ▶️ You can watch the video here: https://lnkd.in/en93S6t9 🧠 It outlines latest research, showing that even a minimal amount of alcohol can impair your brain function and driving ability. 💡 Quick background: Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) is measured in mg of alcohol per 100ml of blood. 🚨 The stats are shocking, because here's the risk of dying by car crash when you compare to someone with no alcohol in their system… BAC 20-50 ➡️ 3x higher risk of death BAC 50-80 ➡️ 6x higher risk of death BAC 80-100 ➡️ 11x higher risk of death 🔑 Key takeaway: the only safe limit is zero, so if you're planning to drive, choose 0% alcohol drinks! 📝 You can take part in the Road Safety consultation by clicking on this survey link (ends today, 11 May at 23:59 GMT): https://lnkd.in/eKjFBDbf #DoctorAzmain #RoadSafety #DepartmentForTransport ...more

When you hear the word "INFLUENCER", what comes to mind? It's a shame that it's often associated with vapid, low value social media content. But I think the true influencers are the ones that use their lived experience and knowledge to positively impact other people's lives. That's why it was such a pleasure to attend Impact Collective's Spring Social event, set up by Charlotte Beeden. She herself has created content for eight years now and built an incredible community of followers. Now she's helping fellow creators too amplify their messaging and multiply the positive impact. It was great to hear from Alfie Green , Ella Thompson and Adam Lind talk about their wealth of experience in the creative space. It was wonderful as ever to see my friends Dr Dev Gakhar and Yasmin Karsan, PhD who are each building incredible things for their own communities! ...more

Pastael has officially launched on Anthropologie.com !!! 🥹🎉 All I can think about is 13-year-old Maddie on her first trip to London, walking into Anthropologie and genuinely thinking she had reached heaven. And maybe do a little manifesting too 👀🤞🏼 A huge thank you to the Anthropologie buying team for believing in Pastael, and to our small team for getting this over the line! 🥹
